root.title: Crank-slider mechanism
root.description: One rotary input becomes a controlled linear stroke. Follow the authored four-second cycle through the crank, connecting rod and carriage.

source.title: Kinetic 01 — tabletop crank-slider
source.author: Pradeep Kaushik
source.kind: Published procedural mechanism study with authored animation; not manufacturer CAD.
source.attribution: Kinetic 01 by Pradeep Kaushik, MIT. Original study produced with an AI agent; presentation metadata and technical edges adapted for Annora Explorer.

cycleBoundsSampling.purpose: Conservative sampled presentation envelope; not a collision bound.

stages.title: Outer travel limit
stages.description: The crank and connecting rod align at the outer end of the 70 mm stroke.

stages.title: Rotary input, linear travel
stages.description: The crank pin turns through 90 degrees as the connecting rod draws the carriage inward.

stages.title: Inner travel limit
stages.description: At 180 degrees the carriage reaches the inner limit and reverses direction.

stages.title: Return stroke
stages.description: The crank continues in the same direction while the rod drives the carriage outward.

groups.title: Crank drive
groups.description: A rotating crank and offset pin provide the rotary input for one complete revolution.

groups.title: Connecting rod
groups.description: The 110 mm link follows the crank pin and transfers its motion to the carriage.

groups.title: Slider carriage
groups.description: The carriage travels 70 mm along the guide while remaining connected to the rod.

groups.title: Linear guide
groups.description: Two fixed rails guide the carriage; the scale makes its travel visible.

groups.title: Frame and supports
groups.description: The base, spindle bearing and fixed supports establish the reference for the moving mechanism.
